# Papa Kojo Mensah

> Papa Kojo Mensah is based in Ghana and brings operations, customer service, data, design and practical digital tools together around one idea: making complex work clearer. His published experience includes customer service at Absa Bank Ghana, historical-record review through Springboard and independent graphic design work.

## Canonical profile

- [Professional portfolio](https://pkm.hayalows.com/): Selected work, experience, skills, education, contact information and a small personal listening panel.
- [One-page CV](https://pkm.hayalows.com/resume/): Concise, printable curriculum vitae.
- [Selected work](https://pkm.hayalows.com/projects/): Problem, approach and evidence notes for three published projects.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/papakojomensah): Public professional profile.

## Current positioning

- Working idea: make complex work clearer.
- Professional areas: operations, customer service, data quality, practical digital tools and design.
- Current opportunities: customer service, operations support and hospitality roles; also project work involving data, design or practical digital tools.
- Current role: Data Entry Specialist at Springboard, remote, from April 2026.
- Education: BSc Actuarial Science, Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, 2024.

## Evidence from published experience

- At Absa Bank Ghana, processed and reviewed 50+ customer and account requests on busy days.
- Built an Excel tool for faster treasury-bill quotations and reduced manual calculation errors.
- Supported 125+ youth accounts in a campaign and a GHS 1 million wholesale investment placement through tracking and follow-up.
- English Chat Finder brings availability from more than 200 conversation calendars into one search.

## Selected projects

- [RouteLab](https://maps.hayalows.com/): A map-first tool for planning, remembering and exploring everyday movement in a calmer flow.
- [Hayalows Ventures](https://hayalows.com/): Brand communication, customer journeys, operations and practical digital systems considered together.
- [English Chat Finder](https://englishchatsession.vercel.app/): A search tool across availability from more than 200 conversation calendars.
